title: done's ledger check attributes to an item the _fetch_state.csv and _anchors.csv rows a later commit of another item changed
goal: bl_land.ledger_moves counts only the ledger rows the item's own commits change, not every row changed from the parent of its first ledger commit to HEAD, so done of item A run after another commit advanced S200 names only A's own rows (SP-7nv2ffr2 review).

gates.question: How does ledger_moves tell the item's own rows from another commit's?
options: per-commit: each item commit read against its own parent, kept when it differs at HEAD from the first such parent
per-commit but compare to the item's last commit, not HEAD
gates.recommendation: per-commit: each item commit read against its own parent, kept when it differs at HEAD from the first such parent

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 13 of 15, "Landing and close: clause credit by carrier, ledger checks by item, the code-lane wait and checks that run behaviour"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates. Premise run at plan time (2026-10-13): the repro exits 1 (ledger_moves names S100 and S200, S200 moved by commit B, not by A).
